title: 3EN002 comprehensive security audit v2
description: Large read-only OpenWrt security audit. Uses a Base64-encoded remote shell payload to avoid PowerShell/SSH quoting failures. Collects listening sockets, processes, SSH/Dropbear, LuCI/uHTTPd, rpcd, firewall/nftables, banIP, enabled services, cron, accounts metadata, packages, mounts, sysctl hardening, network/DNS/DHCP and security-relevant logs. No configuration changes are made.
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $HostIp='192.168.1.2'; $User='root'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $Key)){throw ('SSH key missing: '+$Key)}; Write-Host '=== 3EN002 COMPREHENSIVE SECURITY AUDIT 012b ==='; Write-Host ('Time='+(Get-Date -Format o)); $remote=@'
echo '=== SYSTEM ==='
ubus call system board 2>/dev/null || true
uname -a
uptime
echo
echo '=== LISTENING_SOCKETS ==='
ss -lntup 2>/dev/null || netstat -lntup 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== PROCESSES ==='
ps w 2>/dev/null || ps 2>/dev/null
echo
echo '=== DROPBEAR_CONFIG ==='
uci show dropbear 2>&1 || true
cat /etc/config/dropbear 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== AUTHORIZED_KEYS_META ==='
ls -la /etc/dropbear 2>/dev/null || true
wc -l /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== UHTTPD_CONFIG ==='
uci show uhttpd 2>&1 || true
cat /etc/config/uhttpd 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== RPCD_CONFIG ==='
uci show rpcd 2>&1 || true
cat /etc/config/rpcd 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== FIREWALL_UCI ==='
uci show firewall 2>&1
echo
echo '=== NFT_RULESET ==='
nft list ruleset 2>&1
echo
echo '=== BANIP ==='
if command -v banip-status >/dev/null 2>&1; then banip-status 2>&1; elif [ -x /etc/init.d/banip ]; then /etc/init.d/banip status 2>&1; fi
echo
echo '=== INIT_SERVICES ==='
for f in /etc/init.d/*; do [ -x "$f" ] || continue; n=$(basename "$f"); "$f" enabled >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ENABLED:$n; done
echo
echo '=== CRON ==='
cat /etc/crontabs/root 2>/dev/null || true
ls -la /etc/crontabs 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== ACCOUNTS ==='
cat /etc/passwd 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== SHADOW_META ==='
awk -F: '{if($2=="")s="EMPTY";else if($2 ~ /^!/)s="LOCKED";else s="SET"; print $1 ":" s}' /etc/shadow 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== PACKAGES_SECURITY_RELEVANT ==='
opkg list-installed 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'dropbear|uhttpd|luci|rpcd|firewall|nft|banip|dnsmasq|odhcpd|openssl|wolfssl|mbedtls|wireguard|openvpn|ipsec|strongswan|tailscale|zerotier|adblock|https-dns-proxy|stubby|unbound' || true
echo
echo '=== ALL_PACKAGES ==='
opkg list-installed 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== MOUNTS ==='
mount 2>/dev/null
df -h 2>/dev/null
echo
echo '=== SYSCTL_SECURITY ==='
for k in net.ipv4.ip_forward net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects kernel.randomize_va_space; do printf '%s=' "$k"; sysctl -n "$k" 2>/dev/null || echo NA; done
echo
echo '=== NETWORK ==='
uci show network 2>&1
ip addr 2>&1
ip route 2>&1
echo
echo '=== DNS_DHCP ==='
cat /etc/config/dhcp 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== WAN_RELATED_LOGS ==='
logread 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'dropbear|uhttpd|rpcd|firewall|banip|blocked|reject|wan|auth|login|failed|error|warn' | tail -n 500 || true
echo
echo '=== RECENT_LOGREAD ==='
logread -l 500 2>/dev/null || logread 2>/dev/null | tail -n 500
echo
echo '=== AUDIT_END ==='
'@; $b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($remote)); $remoteCmd="echo '$b64' | base64 -d | sh"; & $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 -o ConnectionAttempts=1 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=1 ($User+'@'+$HostIp) $remoteCmd 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host ('SSH_EXIT_CODE='+$rc); if($rc -ne 0){throw ('Security audit SSH failed rc='+$rc)}; Write-Host 'SECURITY_AUDIT=PASS'
